description: GRC MouseTrapCmd: Command-line variant of GRC MouseTrap for checking the historical WMF/MICE metafile execution issue.
notes: GRC does not publish a static SHA-256 checksum for this download. The manifest omits hash rather than inventing a value.
Legacy vulnerability diagnostic from 2006; not a replacement for current security updates.

script: if (-not $match.Success) { throw 'Unable to read the MouseTrapCmd last-updated date from GRC freeware listing.' }
